visualReview.notes: Main connected villa and bath conservation exterior: mapped apsidal rooms, actual open peristyle and 32 near columns with bases/capitals, timber shelter beams/rafters, generic tiled portico floor, dry shaped courtyard basin, pale infill above stone ruins, grey standing-seam shelters, higher basilica and Great Hunt ranges, stepped western baths and separate red octagonal frigidarium roof/faceted skylight. Closed roof undersides and stepped infill eliminate observed seams. Column bays and court are real voids. Skylight/high window glazing is an opaque exterior proxy; no furnished interior or copied figurative mosaics. Five detached collection members remain separate pending models.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Nine roles use seven existing 256px shared graphs: plaster_lime, stone_limestone_raw (including cream columns), metal_standing_seam (grey/copper tint variants), metal_painted, storefront, wood_plain and tile_mosaic. Metric UVs use canonical graph repeat sizes; generic tile is a tonal proxy, not literal villa mosaic art. No embedded image, private atlas or new graph. Seven textured draws/one skyline draw; separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and equal CPU/GPU geometry bytes. Each used graph reads once per native run; unload disposes geometry.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs 891 / 3812 / 7542 / 11126 triangles; initial skyline+district geometry 392552 bytes, closeup 886992 bytes. Six GLBs zero Khronos errors/warnings; 410 actual mesh/contact probes, three actual PMTiles 13/14/15 cases, one detailed owned parent. Inspected 52 current portable/shared/medium-fi/native frames. Every LOD/failure/unload preserves 42 resident / 43 wider independent buildings, original 201x201/6m terrain/roads and empty water layer. Courtyard/approaches remain original ground except the dry basin. Failure keeps all 43 original resident buildings; unload restores ground/water with zero live geometry.

frameReview.method: Actually inspected all 52 current frames in eleven labeled contact sheets; full-resolution native peristyle, roofscape, red skylight, western baths and whole site also inspected with identical final model bytes. Four ordinary exterior pictures plus standard PMTiles/Mapzen guided one continuous author/inspect/fix pass. Corrected pale shared stone/columns, roof step infill, peristyle wall closure and roof-mode perimeter seams. No bespoke terrain research. Five detached required collection members remain unmodeled; procedural context is not their approval.

limitations: Main connected villa and baths conservation complex only: mapped apsidal room outline and open rectangular peristyle, 32 near-view columns, shallow dry courtyard fountain, pale infill above weathered stone ruins, grey standing-seam roofs, higher basilica/Great Hunt ranges, stepped western baths and red octagonal frigidarium roof with faceted skylight. Triclinium, Xystus rooms/court, entrance remains and two eastern latrines are separate required models. Figurative mosaics, temporary art, furniture, signage and surrounding archaeological park are not copied into this exterior model.
